verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent spec for Stripe's crypto and stablecoin APIs, and the probe found every candidate OpenAPI path returning 404. The llms.txt file, markdown docs, MCP server and CLI are related agent-friendly resources, but none of them is a machine-readable API specification, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
